newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up on short covering.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Tuesday amid squaring of short positions by individuals ahead of a four-day break starting Wednesday, dealers said.
They said the market might open mixed to weak on Sunday amid political uncertainty before general elections set for February 3.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 3.15 points, or 0.23 percent, to end at 1,375.55. Losers led gainers 146 to 97. Turnover rose to 24.58 million shares from 22.13 million on Monday.
Faysal Bank fell 0.20 to 21.80 rupees but Adamjee Insurance rose 1.0 to 89.50. Dewam Salman Fibre rose 1.70 to 30.45 and Nadeem Textile 1.50 to 12.50.
Hub Power Co rose 0.50 to 32.45 and Pakistan State Oil 1.0 to 263. PTCL rose 0.30 to 27.20. ICI Pakistan rose 0.60 to 18.35 and FFC Jordan Fertilizer 0.15 to 14.20.
